five_field_difference_audit.public_problem: Digitally unobserved ordinary public-space tasks may be treated as zero and removed.
named_human_decision: Public-Space Use Steward decides evidence sufficiency
five_field_difference_audit.failure_public_result: Remain UNKNOWN, stop spatial replacement, remove trial components, restore the ordinary task, and publish de-identified failure types.
five_field_difference_audit.nearest_neighbor_difference: Nearby packages mention heatmap limits, low utilization, or reversible components but do not combine evidence sufficiency, an equivalent same-place ordinary-task reserve, separated human entry/restoration decisions, and mandatory restoration as one public task.
five_field_difference_audit.falsification: If a current or future proposal covers the same service users, whole task, carrier, named decision, and failure result, classify as convergent and do not rename/resubmit.

entry_gates.requirement: Coverage gaps are published without identifying people.
The ordinary public task is described in observable task terms.
An equivalent ordinary-task reserve remains in the same place.
All named human roles and the independent veto are present.
Components, signs, and data copies are demonstrably removable.
The complete workflow passes with AI physically off.

human_roles.decision: defines and signs observation coverage and known gaps
decides whether evidence is sufficient to propose a bounded trial
independently vetoes unequal access, task loss, or unsafe observation
signs physical, information, responsibility, and complaint closeout

privacy.retention: delete synthetic run logs within 30 days after review; retain only versioned fixture definitions and de-identified issue types

stop_conditions: real personal data enters the prototype
a named human role or independent veto is missing
fire, accessibility, emergency, or professional safety review fails
public_result_on_stop: switch model and trial equipment off
remove movable components and differential signage
restore ordinary passage, rest, waiting, and staffed service
publish de-identified gap and restoration status
do not collect more personal data as remediation
status_boundary: Concept protocol for synthetic and vacant-space testing only; not a public-space authorization, statutory rule, field result, or government decision.
